title: The Ruvin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: This is what Rabbi Yannai called Yehudah and Chizkiyah, the sons of Rabbi Chiyya, as in Chullin 20a, where he said of them: “Let the ruvin receive their answer.”
In Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah, chapter 3, end of halakhah 4: “Rabbi Yannai said: The ruvei used to say, regarding terumah prepared to the purity standard of consecrated food…”
In Jerusalem Talmud Challah 4:4: “Our Rabbis in the Diaspora used to separate terumah and tithes until the ruvin came and abolished it.” Who are the ruvin? The interpreters.

notes.text: ת״ומ is read as terumah and tithes. The Chagigah and Challah chapter/halakhah locators are Jerusalem Talmud; the interpretations and identification with Rabbi Chiyya’s sons remain the notice’s claims. Saved Guggenheimer English Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:4:10 explicitly has terumah prepared in the purity of sancta; “on top of” is corrected as a purity standard.
